create_modelcard_from_template: create a ModelCard from a template with card data and template kwargs for generating README.md content
load_repo_card_from_hub: load a RepoCard from a Hugging Face Hub repository ID or local filepath
push_repo_card_to_hub: push a RepoCard to a Hugging Face Hub repository with validation and commit options
update_repo_metadata: update metadata in a repository README.md on the Hugging Face Hub with merge or overwrite logic
create_eval_result_metadata: create a metadata dict with evaluation results from a model evaluated on a dataset
